searchText: hello, how do they do they put `block.timestamp` back to accurate after a stop (ie:polygon) ? I had seen on ethereum.org `Check that the timestamp of the block is greater than that of the referenced previous block and less than 15 minutes into the future` Polygon is not a layer2 and also functions differently enough from Ethereum that that would be better asked in a Polygon specific setting. That restriction might be relaxed.
